description: After completing any task, extract reusable rules from what worked and what failed. Produces output in the exact format used by agent.instructions.md (## Mandatory: Rules to Follow / ## Mandatory: Rules to Avoid). Trigger after a task finishes when the user asks for a retrospective, lessons learned, or rule extraction — or implicitly with phrases like "what did we learn", "what went wrong", "what should we avoid next time". Do NOT trigger mid-task or before execution completes.
